commands: set -eu; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "0fe28cc50c0cb2aab19af31aaf4a40a76aff3205"; SERIAL=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | head -1); test -n "$SERIAL"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap 75 160; sleep 1; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/blueeye-drawer.xml >/dev/null; BOUNDS=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cat /sdcard/blueeye-drawer.xml | python3 -c 'import sys,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET,re; r=ET.fromstring(sys.stdin.read()); n=next((x for x in r.iter() if x.attrib.get("text")=="Telemetry & AI Bridge"),None); assert n is not None, "Telemetry drawer item not found"; print(n.attrib["bounds"])'); echo "telemetry_bounds=$BOUNDS"; XY=$(printf '%s' "$BOUNDS" | python3 -c 'import sys,re; s=sys.stdin.read(); a=list(map(int,re.findall(r"\d+",s))); print((a[0]+a[2])//2,(a[1]+a[3])//2)'); set -- $XY; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap "$1" "$2"; sleep 1; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/blueeye-telemetry.xml >/dev/null; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cat /sdcard/blueeye-telemetry.xml | sed 's/></>\n</g' | grep -E 'Telemetry|Google|Drive|Gmail|Connect|Disconnect|Run test|account|authorize|scope|bridge' | head -120
